item.title: MacFace 1.3
item.description:
## MacFace 1.3
First MacFace release, based on glance 1.2.
- Renamed the app to MacFace (new bundle ID `com.aimunich20.macface`) - Updates now come from [MacFace-releases](https://github.com/AImunich20/MacFace-releases) - Recognition, liveness checks and unlocking work the same as glance 1.2
If you used glance before, set MacFace up from scratch: enroll your face and grant Camera and Accessibility again.
